title: Nerve Conduction Studies and EMG — Reading the Report

hook.en: "Slowed conduction", "denervation", "axonal loss". Nerve tests can show where a nerve is injured and how badly, but the timing and the words matter. Learn what they measure and how to use a report.
hook.ur: "Slowed conduction", "denervation", "axonal loss". Nerve tests dikha sakte hain nerve kahan aur kitni zakhmi hai, magar waqt aur alfaz ahem hain. Seekhein yeh kya naapte hain aur report ko kaise istemal karein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain what nerve conduction studies and needle EMG measure, tell demyelination from axonal damage in a report, know when a test can be normal early on and use the result to plan treatment and referral.
goal.ur: End tak aap samjhayenge ke nerve conduction studies aur needle EMG kya naapte hain, report mein demyelination ko axonal nuqsan se alag karenge, jaanenge ke test shuru mein normal kab ho sakta hai aur nateeje ko ilaj aur referral ke plan ke liye istemal karenge.

text.en: **Nerve conduction studies (NCS)** put small electrodes on the skin, give a tiny electric pulse and measure how **fast** (velocity) and how **strongly** (amplitude) the signal travels along a nerve. **Needle EMG** places a fine needle in a muscle and listens to its **electrical activity** at rest and when it contracts. Together they help answer: **Which nerve or root? Where along it? Is the damage to the coating (myelin) or to the nerve fibre itself (axon)? Is it new or old, mild or severe?**
text.ur: **Nerve conduction studies (NCS)** jild par chhote electrodes lagate hain, ek chhota bijli ka pulse dete hain aur naaptay hain ke ishara nerve ke saath kitni **tezi** (velocity) aur kitni **taaqat** (amplitude) se guzarta hai. **Needle EMG** muscle mein baareek soi lagati hai aur aaram aur sikurne ke waqt us ki **bijli ki sargarmi** sunti hai. Milakar yeh in sawalon ka jawab dete hain: **Kaun si nerve ya root? Us ke saath kahan? Nuqsan parde (myelin) ko hai ya nerve ke reshay (axon) ko? Naya hai ya purana, halka ya shadeed?**

text.en: Think of a nerve as **an electric cable**. **Demyelination** is like damaged insulation: the signal still gets through, but slowly or with leakage (slowed velocity). **Axonal damage** is like cut wires inside the cable: fewer wires carry signal, so the signal is weak (low amplitude) and muscles can be "disconnected" (denervation). The test tells you which kind of fault the cable has.
text.ur: Nerve ko **bijli ki taar** samjhein. **Demyelination** kharab insulation jaisi hai: ishara phir bhi guzarta hai, magar aahista ya leak ke saath (velocity kam). **Axonal nuqsan** taar ke andar kate hue taaron jaisa hai: kam taarein ishara le jati hain, is liye ishara kamzor (amplitude kam) aur muscles "kat" sakte hain (denervation). Test batata hai taar mein kis qism ki kharabi hai.

steps.title: Read the clinical question
steps.detail: Check what was suspected (carpal tunnel, a root problem, a nerve palsy, a neuropathy) and the side tested. The conclusion answers that question. || Clinical sawal parhein

steps.title: Understand latency, velocity and amplitude
steps.detail: A long latency or slow velocity points to slowed conduction (often myelin or compression). A small amplitude points to loss of fibres (axonal). A conduction block means the signal fails at one spot. || Latency, velocity aur amplitude samjhein

steps.title: Understand the EMG findings
steps.detail: "Fibrillation potentials" and "positive sharp waves" suggest active denervation; "large, long motor unit potentials" suggest old re-innervation; reduced recruitment means fewer working units. || EMG ki findings samjhein

steps.title: Mind the timing
steps.detail: Needle EMG changes of denervation appear about two to three weeks after nerve injury, so an early test can be normal even when the nerve is badly injured. A normal result does not rule out a problem; a repeat may be needed. || Waqt ka khayal rakhein

question.en: A nerve study shows a very small amplitude with normal velocity. What does this suggest?
question.ur: Nerve study mein amplitude bohat chhoti aur velocity normal hai. Yeh kya batata hai?

feedback.en: That is not shown by this test.
feedback.ur: Yeh is test se nazar nahi aata.
Normal studies mein amplitude normal hoti hai.

text.ur: Nerve ke reshon ka nuqsan (axonal damage)

feedback.en: Yes — fewer fibres carry the signal, so it is weak.
feedback.ur: Haan — kam reshay ishara le jate hain, is liye woh kamzor hai.

rows.ur: Aam taur par barqarar (block na ho to)
2 se 3 haftay baad denervation ki nishaniyan

rows.en: Often good and faster (the coating can repair)
rows.ur: Aksar achhi aur tez (parda marammat kar sakta hai)

rows.en: Slower (the fibre must regrow, about 1 mm a day)
rows.ur: Dheemi (resha dobara ugna hai, takreeban 1 mm din)

text.en: **Speed for the coating, strength for the fibre.** Slow signals mean the coating; weak signals mean the fibres. Remember that denervation takes two to three weeks to show, so a normal early EMG is not a green light.
text.ur: **Raftar parde ke liye, taaqat reshon ke liye.** Dheemay ishare parde, kamzor ishare reshon ki taraf. Yaad rakhein denervation nazar aane mein do se teen haftay lagte hain, is liye shuruati normal EMG green light nahi.

text.en: **Relying on a normal test to dismiss symptoms.** A mild or early nerve problem, or a problem in the small fibres that the test does not measure, can give a normal report. Treat the patient's symptoms and examination, and refer if signs such as weakness progress, whatever the report says.
text.ur: **Normal test par bharosa karke alamaat ko radd kar dena.** Halka ya shuruati nerve ka masla, ya choti reshon ka masla jo test nahi naapta, normal report de sakta hai. Mareez ki alamaat aur examination ka ilaj karein, aur kamzori jaisi nishaniyan barhein to report kuch bhi kahe refer karein.

question.en: Carpal tunnel syndrome is suspected but the nerve study is normal. What is sensible?
question.ur: Carpal tunnel syndrome ka shak hai magar nerve study normal hai. Kya munasib hai?

text.en: Tell the patient there is nothing wrong
text.ur: Mareez ko batayein ke kuch ghalat nahi

text.en: Keep treating on the clinical picture, and consider repeating the test or a specialist opinion if it does not improve
text.ur: Clinical tasveer par ilaj jaari rakhein, aur behtar na ho to test dohrane ya specialist ki raaye par ghaur karein

feedback.en: Yes — early or mild compression can have a normal study.
feedback.ur: Haan — shuruati ya halka dabao mein study normal ho sakti hai.

feedback.en: Treatment should follow the whole picture.
feedback.ur: Ilaj poori tasveer ke mutabiq hona chahiye.

question.ur: EMG par "denervation" ka kya matlab hai?

feedback.en: Denervation means loss of nerve supply.
feedback.ur: Denervation ka matlab nerve supply ka khatam hona.

text.ur: Nerve bilkul theek ho rahi hai

feedback.ur: Yeh chot dikhata hai, marammat nahi.

text.en: Muscle fibres have lost their nerve supply
text.ur: Muscle ke reshon ki nerve supply khatam ho gayi hai

feedback.en: Yes — this is a sign of axonal injury.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh axonal chot ki nishani hai.

text.en: **Use the report to guide loading and timing.** After a nerve injury, protect the nerve, keep joints supple and muscles active in a safe range, and avoid overstretching. Use serial testing and strength measures to track recovery, and refer early if there is no sign of recovery when it is expected.
text.ur: **Report ko loading aur waqt ki rehnumai ke liye istemal karein.** Nerve ki chot ke baad nerve ko bachayein, joints narm aur muscles mehfooz range mein active rakhein, aur zyada khichao se bachein. Recovery ki nigrani ke liye baar baar test aur taaqat ke paimane istemal karein, aur jab recovery mutawaqqa ho aur nishani na ho to jald refer karein.

question.en: Why is an early EMG sometimes normal after a nerve injury?
question.ur: Nerve ki chot ke baad jaldi EMG kabhi normal kyun hota hai?

answer.en: After a nerve is cut or crushed, the part of the nerve beyond the injury takes days to degenerate, and the muscle takes two to three weeks to show the changes of denervation on EMG. A test done too early may therefore look normal even though the nerve is badly injured.
answer.ur: Nerve kat jane ya kuchle jane ke baad chot ke aage ka hissa kharab hone mein din lete hain, aur muscle EMG par denervation ki tabdeeliyan dikhane mein do se teen haftay leta hai. Bohat jaldi kiya gaya test is liye normal ho sakta hai chahe nerve bohat zakhmi ho.

beats.patient: A 36-year-old man has a wrist drop after sleeping with his arm over a chair, and a nerve study at one week is reported as "no conduction block, EMG normal". The strength of wrist extension is grade 1.
beats.assessment: The clinical picture (wrist drop, weak extensors) is a radial nerve palsy; a normal early study does not rule out axonal damage and should be repeated.
beats.treatment: Protect the wrist with a splint, keep range of movement, start gentle active exercise and arrange a repeat study at three weeks.
beats.reassess: At three weeks the study shows partial axonal loss, and he starts to recover over the following months.

text.en: **Refer urgently** for rapidly progressing weakness, a foot or wrist drop after trauma, signs of cord compression, bladder or bowel changes, a nerve injury with severe uncontrolled pain, or loss of function in a nerve that crosses an open wound. Do not mobilise or stretch an injured nerve aggressively.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** tezi se barhti kamzori, trauma ke baad foot drop ya wrist drop, cord compression ki nishaniyan, peshab ya pakhane mein tabdeeliyan, shadeed be-qaboo dard ke saath nerve ki chot, ya khuli chot ke paas se guzarne wali nerve ka function khatam hona. Zakhmi nerve ko zor se hilayen ya na khainchein.

summary.en: NCS measure how fast and how strongly a nerve conducts; needle EMG listens to muscle activity.
summary.ur: NCS naaptay hain ke nerve kitni tezi aur taaqat se conduct karti hai; needle EMG muscle ki sargarmi sunti hai.

summary.en: Slow conduction suggests the coating (demyelination); low amplitude and denervation suggest fibre loss (axonal damage).
summary.ur: Dheemi conduction parde (demyelination) ki taraf; kam amplitude aur denervation reshon ke nuqsan (axonal damage) ki taraf ishara karti hain.

summary.en: Remember the timing: a normal early test does not rule out a nerve injury; treat the clinical picture and repeat or refer.
summary.ur: Waqt yaad rakhein: shuruati normal test nerve ki chot rule out nahi karta; clinical tasveer ka ilaj karein aur dohrayein ya refer karein.
